# Chart.js 4.5.1

Pinned official UMD distribution, downloaded from the npm Chart.js package via
jsDelivr. No CDN requests are made at runtime, no Node build system is needed.

- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.5.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js
- Chart.js MIT license: LICENSE.md
- Bundled @kurkle/color 0.3.2 MIT license: LICENSE-color.md
- SHA256: 48444a82d4edcb5bec0f1965faacdde18d9c17db3063d042abada2f705c9f54a

Keep the version, bundle, licenses, checksum and analytics browser checks in sync
when upgrading. Python computes all statistics; this library only draws charts.
